bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; n=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tAqc "WITH a AS (SELECT owner_user_id,updated_at FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='announcement' AND data->>'recruitmentFlow'='compact' AND step IN ('awaiting_text','awaiting_recruitment_edit')), c AS (SELECT owner_user_id,updated_at FROM profile_drafts WHERE step <> 'cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT owner_user_id,updated_at FROM public_post_drafts WHERE NOT (module='announcement' AND data->>'recruitmentFlow'='compact') UNION ALL SELECT owner_user_id,updated_at FROM room_host_sessions WHERE expires_at>NOW()) SELECT count(DISTINCT a.owner_user_id) FROM a JOIN c USING(owner_user_id) WHERE c.updated_at>a.updated_at" | tr -d '[:space:]'); case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 73;; esac; if test "$n" -gt 0; then exit 81; fi; exit 0
